node.title: Conductor-128 full-unit circular basis
node.closure: Miller descent, Weber oddness, and Kummer-Sinnott unit-index formula
node.statement: Every unit of Z[zeta_128] is a root of unity times a unique product of the 31 standard real circular units eta_a for odd 3<=a<=63.
node.notes: UNIT BASIS 2026-07-29: Miller's unconditional conductor-256 plus-class-number theorem descends to conductor 128 by extension/norm and Weber oddness. Kummer-Sinnott then makes the 31 circular generators the full unit basis.
